values.note: 24 sites reservable, 30 first-come (the Forest Service page says 19 reservable); every site is first-come in the spring and September shoulder seasons. Booking closes 4 days before arrival. Saving sites is prohibited.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232251 ('54 sites, 30 are first come-first serve and 24 can be reserved'; rules reservationCutOff 4 day(s) prior to arrival, maxConsecutiveStay 16; notice '16 Day Stay Limit'; rate table First-come, First-served Seasons) + Forest Service page ('Nineteen sites are available for reservation on Recreation.gov'), read 2026-10-22

note: Kootenai NF, on an arm of Lake Koocanusa near Rexford, 7 mi from Eureka; ponderosa pine at ~2,470 ft. High- and low-water boat ramps, fish-cleaning stations, swim beach, interpretive loop and the Hoodoo Trail to sandstone formations. The beach/recreation area above the high-water mark (with its flush restrooms) and the Kamloops overflow parking are closed for water/wastewater system work from July 13 until October 30, 2026; the campground stays open (Forest Service alert, read 2026-10-22). --Claude
summary: Forest Service page + alert + recreation.gov (Forest Service, Rexford/Fortine RD; mixed reservable/FCFS): confirmed $24, no hookups, 54 sites, flush toilets, water, recreation.gov with some FCFS; max_rig_ft changed 60 -> 50 (rec.gov catalogue); added dump, 4-day cutoff, 16-night limit, the 50% Senior/Access discount the page states; season close 09-07 (a rate-season edge) cleared (FS gives only 'Late April'). Vault toilets left (pages mention only flush). Partial beach-area construction closure through 2026-10-30 put in the note (the campground itself is open). Note trimmed of restated values.
